decision_notes: Own assembly website designates its recording provider. 80th ordinary sitting 20 October 2026: Sérgio Aguiar at the lectern with an inset interpreter; Work/Administration/Public Service committee with table business. Committee title/description says 20 September while displayed upload timing suggests October; exact committee date remains unreconciled. Two selected recordings decode and advance in Chromium and WebKit; captured Chromium frames were visually reviewed, with additional WebKit visual review for the new Ceará and Paraíba samples. Muted samples do not certify audible quality, current live or complete room coverage.

Official institutional viewing link only. No independent blanket audiovisual reuse grant was established from the reviewed source navigation. Personal-use permission remains pending; no provider embed, extracted media, rehosting or IPTV export is added.
